Org-admin surfaces: the metadata and template definitions that shape what work items can carry.

## metadata-definitions

### `GET /api/metadata-definitions`

List metadata definitions with their enum options and scopes (open
tenant-wide), optionally filtered to one entity type's catalog.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |
| `entity_type` | query | no | `string` | Only definitions applying to this entity type (`strategy|initiative|task|document|adr`): unscoped definitions plus those whose scopes include it. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_MetadataDefinition`](../schemas/#listenvelope_metadatadefinition) | Page of definitions |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad entity_type value |

### `POST /api/metadata-definitions`

Create a metadata definition (org admin only, A-0006).

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateMetadataDefinitionRequest`](../schemas/#createmetadatadefinitionrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`MetadataDefinition`](../schemas/#metadatadefinition) | Created |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Caller is not an org admin |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Bad field_type, option rules, or duplicate slug |

### `GET /api/metadata-definitions/{id}`

Get one definition with its enum options (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the definition |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`MetadataDefinition`](../schemas/#metadatadefinition) | The definition |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown slug or id |

### `DELETE /api/metadata-definitions/{id}`

Delete a definition (org admin only). Refused with 409
`DEFINITION_IN_USE` while any item value or template association
references it (S-0005 "fails if in use") — and the refusal names the
carrying work and templates, archived carriers marked (KAIROS-T-0162).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the definition |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](../schemas/#deletedresponse) | Deleted |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Caller is not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown slug or id |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Definition is in use; the message names the carrying items and templates |

### `PATCH /api/metadata-definitions/{id}`

Update a definition (org admin only): rename, re-slug, and/or replace
the enum option list. The field type is immutable — existing
`item_metadata` values were validated against it (A-0003).

A body with no field is a 422 `VALIDATION`. A body whose values are
equal to the stored values writes nothing and makes no activity entry.
A real change makes an activity entry (KAIROS-T-0268).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the definition |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateMetadataDefinitionRequest`](../schemas/#updatemetadatadefinitionrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`MetadataDefinition`](../schemas/#metadatadefinition) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Caller is not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown slug or id |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No field to change, option rules, or duplicate slug |

## templates

### `GET /api/templates`

List templates (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` | Page size (default 50, max 200). |
| `offset` | query | no | `integer` | Rows to skip (default 0). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`ListEnvelope_Template`](../schemas/#listenvelope_template) | Page of templates |

### `POST /api/templates`

Create a template (org admin only, A-0006). Metadata entries reference
existing definitions by slug; defaults are validated against the
definition's type (A-0003).

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`CreateTemplateRequest`](../schemas/#createtemplaterequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [`TemplateDetail`](../schemas/#templatedetail) | Created |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Caller is not an org admin |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown definition slug, invalid default, duplicate slug, or an unknown section type or bad heading |

### `GET /api/templates/{id}`

Get one template: content plus its associated metadata definitions
with defaults/required flags (open tenant-wide).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the template |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`TemplateDetail`](../schemas/#templatedetail) | The template with its metadata fields |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown slug or id |

### `DELETE /api/templates/{id}`

Delete a template (org admin only). Hard delete: associations cascade
and existing documents keep their content (`documents.template_id` is
set NULL by the DDL).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the template |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`DeletedResponse`](../schemas/#deletedresponse) | Deleted |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Caller is not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown slug or id |

### `PATCH /api/templates/{id}`

Update a template (org admin only): omitted fields are unchanged;
`metadata` replaces the full association list. Existing documents are
unaffected (A-0003: no ongoing relationship after stamping).

A body with no field is a 422 `VALIDATION`. A body whose values are
equal to the stored values writes nothing and makes no activity entry.
A real change makes an activity entry (KAIROS-T-0268).

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | yes | `string` | The slug or the id (UUID) of the template |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`UpdateTemplateRequest`](../schemas/#updatetemplaterequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`TemplateDetail`](../schemas/#templatedetail) | Updated |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Caller is not an org admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Unknown slug or id |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | No field to change, unknown definition slug, invalid default, duplicate slug, or an unknown section type or bad heading |

## organization

### `GET /api/admin/jobs`

The job queue of the organization and of the deployment.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`JobQueueStatus`](../schemas/#jobqueuestatus) | The jobs by kind and state, and the last failures |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is not an organization admin |

### `GET /api/org/code-index-settings`

The provider settings of the code index of the tenant. The secrets are
a status, never the value.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`CodeIndexSettings`](../schemas/#codeindexsettings) | The settings |

### `PUT /api/org/code-index-settings`

Set the provider settings of the code index of the tenant (an
organization admin). The answer has each secret as a status.

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`PutCodeIndexSettings`](../schemas/#putcodeindexsettings)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`CodeIndexSettings`](../schemas/#codeindexsettings) | The settings as Kairos keeps them now |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an organization admin |
| `409` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The version is not the stored version: the settings changed after the read; details.current has them |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | An unknown provider or field, a value that a provider needs and the body does not give, or a value that is not correct |
| `501` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | A secret was sent, and this deployment has no KAIROS_SECRETS_KEY |

### `GET /api/org/read-tokens`

The read tokens of the organization: the host, who set the token and
when (an organization admin). Never the token.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`OrgReadToken`](../schemas/#orgreadtoken) | The token of each host, as a status |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an organization admin |

### `PUT /api/org/read-tokens/{host}`

Set or replace the read token of the organization for a forge host (an
organization admin). Kairos encrypts the token. The builder uses it for
each repository on the host, before the token of the repository.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | path | yes | `string` | The forge host, for example github.com |

Request body (required): `application/json`, [`SetOrgReadTokenRequest`](../schemas/#setorgreadtokenrequest)

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`OrgReadToken`](../schemas/#orgreadtoken) | The token is set |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an organization admin |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | An unknown field, a host that is not a host, or a token that is empty, too long or has a space |
| `501` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | This deployment has no KAIROS_SECRETS_KEY |

### `DELETE /api/org/read-tokens/{host}`

Remove the read token of the organization for a forge host (an
organization admin). The next fetch of a repository on the host uses the
token of the repository, or no token. The answer is the list that stays.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | path | yes | `string` | The forge host, for example github.com |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | array of [`OrgReadToken`](../schemas/#orgreadtoken) | The token is removed; the tokens that stay |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | Not an organization admin |
| `404` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The host has no token |
| `422` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | A host that is not a host |

### `GET /api/org/retention`

The retention settings of the deployment and the last pass.

| Response | Body | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [`RetentionStatus`](../schemas/#retentionstatus) | The retention settings and the last pass |
| `403` | [`ErrorEnvelope`](../schemas/#errorenvelope) | The caller is not an organization admin |
